name: Summer Fashion Institute
org: Kansas State University College of Health and Human Sciences
what_you_do: High school students try fashion design, illustration and sewing, and bring their own designs to life in a short K-State camp. No sewing experience needed.
who_can_apply: High school students in grades 9 to 12. The page lists 12 spots.
deadline_text: Camp is June 7 to 10, 2027. Registration dates are not posted; join the 2027 interest list.
how_to_apply: Join the 2027 Interest List linked on the youth programs page. Details are added when available.
notes: The same page also lists Farm to Fashion. It is for grades 7 to 12, June 28 to July 1, 2027, with 15 spots and cost not yet posted. It also lists a free one-day Social Impact Lab for grades 7 to 10 in spring 2028.
